g.text: Mode A, one real run: the Witness conducts call 06

text.tspan: 1 This is an AI assistant, and this call is recorded.
May I have your name and badge number?
2 Member ID and date of service.
What is the status of the claim?
On July eighth, badge two two one zero, reference
eight K two J three three eight, said no prior authorization.
4 On August fifth, T. Okafor, reference eight K two J seven zero two,
recorded reprocessed. Can you confirm that?

g.text: I don't have a record of a call on August fifth.

text.tspan: Our record shows that call and its reference. Can you look it up?

g.text: I'd have to look into that.

text.tspan: 6 What is the reason on the remit?
Which diagnosis code? What is the remark code?
There's also a diagnosis issue. It doesn't specify.
I'd have to refer you to the denial letter.

g.text: 7 Could I get a reference number for this call?
8 Let me read that back: eight K two J nine eight eight. Is that correct?
reference confirmed by a new row
9 Recap spoken from the rows. The gate is clear, so the session ends.
